problem_statement: The stdio subsystem must provide a `stdio_notify` module with a function `stdio_set_notify(void (*cb)(void *arg), void *arg)` that registers a single callback to be invoked in ISR context whenever new data becomes available on stdin. The callback must be invoked by the active stdio backend when received input is placed into stdin, so an application thread that is sleeping on thread flags can wake when input arrives without blocking in `stdio_read()`. After such a wake-up, the thread must be able to drain and echo available stdin data, while still remaining able to wake from other events such as a timer. When no callback is registered, stdin handling must behave as before.
